tasks.subject: Task 1: Part A — store last_chunk_metadata in patch 0002 + harden Dockerfile (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Patched CHUNKED-BATCHES branch stores chunk_metadata on doc_processor.last_chunk_metadata (host-runnable test); Dockerfile patch loop fails build on mis-applied patch.

**Files:** Create docker/docling-graph/tests/test_chunked_batches_stores_chunk_metadata.py; Modify docker/docling-graph/patches/0002-...patch; Modify docker/docling-graph/Dockerfile.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Test applies patch stack to temp repo, drives ExtractionStage._extract_from_docling_document via chunked branch, asserts last_chunk_metadata carries self_refs+pages; fails pre-edit, passes post-edit.
- BARE assignment `doc_processor.last_chunk_metadata = chunk_metadata` (no try/except) after extract_chunks_with_metadata, before `if context.trace_data:`.
- Dockerfile loop `patch -p1 --fuzz=0 -i "$p" || exit 1`.
- All 5 patches dry-run offset 0, no fuzz, no FAILED.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest docker/docling-graph/tests/test_chunked_batches_stores_chunk_metadata.py -v


tasks.subject: Task 3: Part B — resolve synthesizer self_refs to precise chunks (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A #/texts/N self_ref element_uid resolves to its SPECIFIC chunk(s) via the persisted identity_map, not all-chunks fan-out — precise EXTRACTED_FROM.

**Files:** Modify app/workers/pipeline.py (derive_structure_links #/-fallback ~9310-9334); Create tests/unit/test_extracted_from_self_ref_resolution.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- #/... self_ref translated via identity_map (docling_document.json _enrichments.identity_map, pipeline.py:4836) → element_uid → element_uid_chunk_map → specific chunk(s) before the all-chunks fan-out.
- Fan-out is LAST resort only; WARN naming unresolved self_ref.
- Unit test: precise resolution to single chunk + flagged fallback when unmapped.
- Concrete {page}-{order}-... element_uid path unchanged (no regression).

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_extracted_from_self_ref_resolution.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 5: Harden verifier + end-to-end PRECISE-lineage gate (USER-ORDERED)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make verify_lineage_e2e.py prove THIS run restored PRECISE lineage (not pre-satisfied by MENTIONED_IN/stale entities), then run on fresh SA-2 graph_only on the fixed build; confirm precise entity→chunk→page on the graph-query endpoint.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user this conversation. MUST NOT be closed by walking around it or substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently with output captured.

**Files:** Modify scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- #1 run-attributed EXTRACTED_FROM delta: --pre-extracted-from <N>; PASS requires post>pre (pre=0). Hard discriminator.
- #2 drop false-FAIL entity-count delta (idempotent upsert→0); keep absolute entities≥baseline sanity.
- #3 precision assertion: median per-entity EXTRACTED_FROM target chunks ≪ doc chunk count (<25%); report distribution.
- #4 trace uses EXTRACTED_FROM only; warnings scoped to run window.
- Fresh SA-2: EXTRACTED_FROM post>0, 0 no-chunk-metadata warnings, element_uid>0, precision passes, /v1/graph/query SNR-75 sources carry document_id+page and small target count.
- ALL CHECKS PASS.

**Verify:** python3 scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py --run <run_id> --pre-extracted-from 0 → ALL CHECKS PASS
